about: Sessions against the TypeScript gateway. A step is join/leave (a device), phone (a frame it sends; raw = bytes that are not a frame), publish (a bus event), route (a new answer); hold = the next step follows in the same burst. frames: what each device received before the next step, as the frame's JSON text (the bridge's random epoch written <epoch>) and whether it travelled deflated. calls: every route read, in order, and whether it carried the user's token. audit: the audit log at the end.

scenarios.name: join, hello and controls
scenarios.about: The snapshot on join, the first hello riding it, replies, an asset, refusals, a bad body, what the audit log keeps.

scenarios.name: events, focus and pushed rows
scenarios.about: Everything until the phone says what it shows; then the open worker's live events, its rows and live text; another Mac on screen gets patches only.

scenarios.name: row patches
scenarios.about: Change topics become one patch per changed row, read from the list routes; nothing is read while no phone is connected.

scenarios.name: two phones
scenarios.about: An event only some phones get does not take a new seq; terminal output goes to the phones showing that terminal; a deflate phone gets large frames packed.
